premise: Caterpillar crawls up the serious old tree and Woodpecker taps his bark, and the tree laughs so hard his leaves shake down.
inspiration: The folk tale of the serious king who could not laugh, turned: the smallest tickles, not the grandest jester, do it.
lesson: A little silliness is good for everyone, even the oldest.

en-US.title: The Ticklish Tree
en-US.text: The old tree {tree:pulse} was very serious. He never laughed. Not once, in a hundred years. Then one morning, Caterpillar {caterpillar:pulse} started to climb him. Wiggle, wiggle, up his bark. [surprised] The tree {tree:wobble} twitched. Hmm, he rumbled. What's that? Then Woodpecker {woodpecker:pulse} landed on a branch. {woodpecker:live} He tapped the trunk, {sfx:tap} tap, tap, tap, listened, shook off the dust and chirped. [giggles] The tree {tree:shake} shivered. Wiggle, wiggle. Tap, tap. Wiggle, tap! [laughs] And the old tree burst out laughing: HO, HO, HO! {tree:wobble x3} {canvas:leaves 0.7 8s} {sfx:leaves} His branches shook, and a shower of leaves came tumbling down. [happily] You're ticklish! cried Caterpillar. Only a tiny bit, said the tree, still chuckling. {tree:sparkle} [softly] And ever since, he has been the happiest tree in the forest.

es-ES.title: El árbol cosquilloso
es-ES.text: El viejo árbol {tree:pulse} era muy serio. Nunca se reía. Ni una vez, en cien años. Hasta que una mañana, Oruga {caterpillar:pulse} empezó a trepar por él. Meneo, meneo, corteza arriba. [surprised] El árbol {tree:wobble} se estremeció. Mmm, gruñó. ¿Qué es eso? Entonces el pájaro carpintero {woodpecker:pulse} se posó en una rama. {woodpecker:live} Dio unos golpecitos en el tronco, {sfx:tap} toc, toc, toc, escuchó, se sacudió el polvo y pió. [giggles] El árbol {tree:shake} tembló. Meneo, meneo. Toc, toc. ¡Meneo, toc! [laughs] Y el viejo árbol soltó una carcajada: ¡JO, JO, JO! {tree:wobble x3} {canvas:leaves 0.7 8s} {sfx:leaves} Se le sacudieron las ramas, y cayeron montones de hojas. [happily] ¡Tienes cosquillas!, gritó Oruga. Solo un poquitín, dijo el árbol, todavía riéndose. {tree:sparkle} [softly] Y desde entonces es el árbol más feliz del bosque.

tap.prompt: a woodpecker tapping three light knocks on tree bark

leaves.prompt: a tree's branches shaking and a shower of leaves rustling down
